[[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Below Average (Without Shield) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Freeze}} }} __TOC__ == Description == The '''Frost Ravager''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] as part of the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. Currently, it can only appear in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, though in there it is quite broken as most of its functionality is gone. It had an extremely high amount of health, but luckily it had quite slow speed. The '''Frost Ravager''' also had freeze immunity. Initially, the '''Frost Ravager''' spawned with a shield, which granted it [[Shield Health]], in which you cannot earn any money from the '''Frost Ravager'''. It also had 50% [[defense]] when it had its shield, reducing most forms of damage. When it lost its shield, it no longer had defense, but it would have increased speed. == Appearance == The '''Frost Ravager''' had arctic blue skin. Its arms were slightly crystallized. The '''Frost Ravager''' had dark blue granite legs and torso. Three neon white crystals could be seen on the '''Frost Ravager's''' torso. It also had blue spikes sticking out of its shoulders and arms. It had white glowing menacing eyes. When it spawned, the '''Frost Ravager''' carried a large white ice shield across its front. == Event Strategy == As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers, such as the [[Ranger]] or [[Accelerator]], are recommended to take down the '''Frost Ravager'''. **You should use the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability to boost the firerate of these towers. **You can use the [[DJ Booth]] to increase the range of your towers to prevent this enemy from going out of range of your defenses. *[[Defense]] is ignored by splash damage, meaning that towers and [[units]] that deal splash damage will deal 100% damage if the '''Frost Ravager''' is caught in the center of the explosion. **This makes the [[Mortar]] somewhat useful against the '''Frost Ravager''' but be wary, since the [[Mortar]] has low DPS for its cost. **Upon collision, [[units]], like the [[Railgun Tank]], will ignore [[defense]] and deal full collision damage to the '''Frost Ravager'''. *You can use towers like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Electroshocker]] to reduce the defense of the '''Frost Ravager''', allowing your towers to kill it faster. **Note that the '''Frost Ravager''' will lose its [[defense]] once it loses its [[Shield Health]]. **Additionally, as with all enemies in the [[Frost Invasion Event]], the [[Pyromancer]] deals double fire damage to the '''Frost Ravager''' (though normal damage is not doubled). ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFrostRav21.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} WinterThumbnail.png|'''Frost Ravager''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} FrostInvasion.png|'''Frost Ravager''' on the game thumbnail. FrostUpdateIcon.png|'''Frost Ravager''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} CodePI1.jpg|'''Frost Ravager''' on a promotional image. 1BillionCode.jpg|'''Frost Ravager''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} LobbyRender2.png|'''Frost Ravager''' on a render. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Frost Invasion Trailer|'''Frost Ravager''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FrostInvasionFrostRavagerIconIG.png|'''Frost Ravager''' on its [[Index]] icon. FrostRavagerSideOld.png|'''Frost Ravager''''s side view. }} == Trivia == *In terms of appearance, the '''Frost Ravager''' was similar to the [[Frost Invader (Frost Invasion)|Frost Invader]]. *The '''Frost Ravager's''' shield was similar to the [[Vindicator (Legacy)|Vindicator]]'s in terms of functionality. **Unlike the [[Vindicator (Legacy)|Vindicator]], the '''Frost Ravager''' will speed up when it loses its Shield. *On the [[Frost Invasion Event]] thumbnail, the '''Frost Ravager''' has dark blue skin instead of blue skin, and a dark blue shield instead of a grey one. This appearance was never seen in-game. == Update History == *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Frost Ravager''' added. *'''4 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]] **'''Frost Ravager''' removed. *'''20 December 2024''' - [[v1.47.0]] **'''Frost Ravager''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Frost Ravager]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. **{{Bug}} '''Frost Ravager''' has its hitbox stuck at the entrance, making the enemy itself untargetable. It will also get stuck at the exit because of this. **{{Bug}} Nothing happens after losing its [[Shield Health]]. **{{Bug}} Name is ''Frost Ravager Legacy'' instead of ''Frost Ravager''. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0]] **No longer copies the statistics of the modern version in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{FrostInvasion|[[Frost Invader (Frost Invasion)|Frost Invader]]|Wave 14|Frost Ravager|Wave 16|[[Crying Angel (Frost Invasion)|Crying Angel]], [[Frost Hero (Frost Invasion)|Frost Hero]] & [[Frost Necromancer (Frost Invasion)|Frost Necromancer]]|Wave 19}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Frost Ravager}}
